method: UI in Claude in Chrome session, the test account, pt-BR. Nothing was sent.
steps_run: Opened Marketing > Modelos (/templates/listing, empty), pressed 'Criar modelo'
Dialog 'Qual modelo você deseja criar?': chose 'Modelo de e-mail' (others: Modelo do WhatsApp, Modelo push [crown])
Landed on /templates/email/create, default name 'Novo modelo', status Inativa
Clicked the pencil, replaced the name with ZZ_TEST_template_1 and confirmed with the check mark; the URL changed to /templates/email/edit/2 at this point
Typed the subject 'ZZ_TEST template subject' (sender and sender name were preset: the account e-mail and the account name)
Opened the 'Salvar' menu (options: Salvar, Salvar e ativar) and chose 'Salvar'
results: Listing shows ZZ_TEST_template_1, #2, 'Última edição feita em 22 de out. de 2026 5:05 PM', status Inativo
Row menu: Pré-visualização, Duplicar, Ativar, Excluir
observations: No content was added (the 'Adicionar conteúdo' step was skipped) and the save still succeeded, so content is not required to save an inactive template.
Warning shown under the sender: the domain is not authenticated and Brevo replaces it with @brevosend.com.
The record already existed as a draft (edit/2) before 'Salvar' was pressed, so the ID may be allocated when the name is confirmed.
limitations: Template content (drag-and-drop, simple or HTML editor) was not built.
'Salvar e ativar' was not used, so what activation changes is not verified.
The save request body was not captured.
test_data_left_in_account: e-mail template ZZ_TEST_template_1 (ID 2, inactive), to be removed by the account owner
